intro: Our Upmods Flowr makes storage feel serene. With a floral headboard and ample underbed storage, it blends design with utility—no compromise, all comfort.

features.title: Strong, graceful, and made with intention
features.text: Our engineered wood frame offers dependable strength beneath the surface, while the details above make this bed a centrepiece worth coming home to.

features.title: Floral charm, carved with care
features.text: Our intricately carved floral headboard brings a touch of artistry into your bedroom — elegant and expressive, for a space that feels truly personal.

features.title: Box storage that lifts with ease
features.text: Designed with a lift-up mechanism, our underbed storage helps you keep things tidy and within reach — without bending, shifting, or searching. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Crafted to soothe the senses
features.text: The wood grain matte finish lends a natural, tactile feel to your room — soft, subtle, and made to help you unwind at the end of each day.

features.title: Protected beauty, built to last
features.text: A scratch-resistant foil on the headboard preserves its fine detail and finish — keeping it safe from bumps, marks, and everyday wear.

name: Upmods Flowr King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
